up: Retrieve all activity records for assay CHEMBL1614530. For each record, return the exact activity value (activities.standard_value), the activity standard relation (activities.standard_relation), the activity standard type (activities.standard_type), and the standard units (activities.standard_units). Additionally, provide the canonical SMILES string for the tested compound.
sql: SELECT activities.standard_value, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614530'
